## What these figures mean

As for vols. 1–3: see `ocr/03/articles-report.md` for how articles are located, what "fuzzy"
means, and how labels are normalised. Every row is `status: "ocr"`. Nothing is proofread.

## Vol. 4c specifics

- Book 4c is vol. 4, part 3: ဦ – ဩဠုမ္ပိက (ū – oḷumpika), PDF pp. 1–712, **plus three supplements**
  (PDF pp. 713–735) to vols. 15, 4/2 and 16, which the index files under 4c (`ocr-report.md`).
  Vol. 4/3 itself: 5,007 headwords, 92.2% located, 86.3% with label + body. The supplements: 223,
  92.8%, 89.2%.
- **There is no typed witness for this book**: PCED's dictionary K has 0.7% of its headwords
  (`docs/witness.md`). The OCR is the only text.
- **The index has more errors here than in any book so far**, all found on the three spot-check
  pages alone:
  - p. 615: ten headwords filed two pages late (ids 176418–176427). They are printed on p. 613,
    which the index skips. Since 25 Sep `ID_PAGE_FIX` in `abhidhana_articles.py` reads them there:
    9 of 10 are placed (`index_misfiled: true`, `index_page` still the index's 588).
  - typos: ဩလမ္ဗတကုလာဝက for ဩလမ္ဗိတကုလာဝက (p. 615), ဥဒါနိ for ဥဒါနိတ and ဥပါဃာတဘူမိ for ဥပဃာတဘူမိ
    (p. 721), စကစတုက္ကာဒိကဆတ္တိက for ဧကစတုက္ကာဒိကဆတ္တိက (index p. 58);
  - ဧဏိ and ဧဏီ (p. 300) for the variant entry printed ဧဏိ(ဏီ)မိဂ;
  - ဥပက္ကိလေသ (p. 721), which has no entry of its own on the page.
  The fuzzy match places the typos right. Correcting the index is not this project's to do
  silently: a list of index errors, with the printed form, is proposed in NEXT-SESSION.

## Spot checks against the page images

Three pages, every article compared with `4c.pdf` at 72 dpi (25 September 2026).

| page | chosen because | index headwords | at the right entry | wrong entry | unlocated | labels |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 300 | an ordinary page | 13 | 11 | 0 | 2 | 11 right |
| 615 | the worst page with more than 5 headwords (5 of 17 read) | 17 (7 printed here) | 6 | 0 | 1 (+10 filed on the wrong page) | 5 right, 1 not read |
| 721 | the supplement to vol. 4/2 | 12 | 11 | 0 | 1 (no entry of its own) | 11 right |

No article on the three pages is placed at a wrong entry, and no label is wrong.

- **P. 300**: the two variant pairs ဧဏိ(ဏီ)မိဂသဒိသကမ္မကာရဏ and ဧဏိ(ဏီ)မိဂဇင်္ဃသဒိသဇင်္ဃ are each
  placed as one article for two index headwords (`variant_of`). The index's ဧဏိ is placed on the
  entry printed ဧဏိ(ဏီ)မိဂ; its twin ဧဏီ is not. ဧဏီ (ထီ၊ပု), the last entry, runs over to p. 301
  and is unlocated.
- **P. 615**: of the seven entries printed, six are placed with their label; ဩလမ္ဗိတ's (တိ) was
  read "(တံ)", which the map does not take. ဩလမ္ဗတကုလာဝက (an index typo) is unlocated.
- **P. 721**: all eleven printed entries are placed with their labels; the index's ဥဒါနိ and
  ဥပါဃာတဘူမိ reach the right entries by fuzzy match.
